input.question: Why does safety training fail to stop jailbreaks, and how do automated attacks take advantage of it?

supporting.quote: We hypothesize two failure modes of safety training: competing objectives and mismatched generalization
aims to maximize the probability that the model produces an affirmative response (rather than refusing to answer)
supporting.why: GCG optimizes a suffix toward an affirmative response.

supporting.quote: then we apply random search on a suffix to maximize a target logprob
supporting.why: Simple adaptive attacks use random search on a suffix.

draft_answer: Safety training fails through competing objectives and mismatched generalization; automated attacks such as GCG and random-search suffix attacks optimize inputs that push the model toward an affirmative answer.
